features.name: Omnichannel Inbox – All Your Customer Conversations in One Place
features.content: Customers contact businesses through WhatsApp, email, Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook Messenger and website live chat. MSG91 Hello combines these supported channels into a shared inbox, giving agents access to conversations, customer histories and ticket details in one workspace. For businesses operating several brands or regional accounts, One Inbox lets authorised users access different company accounts without repeatedly switching between separate dashboards.

FaqsComp.heading: Frequently Asked Questions – MSG91 Hello Singapore

faqs.question: What is customer support software, and why do Singapore businesses need it?
faqs.answer:
• Customer support software helps businesses organize customer conversations, assign tickets, automate routine inquiries, and improve service quality.
  • In Singapore, customers may contact brands through WhatsApp, email, website chat, Instagram, or Facebook Messenger. Handling these channels independently makes it harder to track issues and maintain consistent service.
  • MSG91 Hello is customer support software for Singapore businesses that brings these interactions into one shared inbox.
  • It combines AI chatbots, ticket management, automation, analytics, and team collaboration. Businesses can add unlimited agents without individual per-agent license fees, making it useful for growing retail brands, financial service teams, hospitality businesses, and service providers.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Hello, and how does it work for Singapore companies?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello is AI customer support software in Singapore that combines an omnichannel inbox with ticketing, chatbot automation, and performance reporting.
  • Businesses connect customer communication channels, invite agents, and configure workflows to distribute incoming inquiries.
  • The no-code builder helps teams set up an initial agentic AI chatbot using a prompt. Rule-based steps and API connections can be added when the workflow needs specific information.
  • For example, a Singapore insurance services company can use AI to answer general policy questions while transferring account-specific inquiries to an authorized representative.
  • Managers can track ticket status, agent activity, and customer feedback from one dashboard.

faqs.question: Which communication channels does MSG91 Hello support in Singapore?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello helps businesses manage WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, email, website live chat, SMS, RCS, X (Twitter), and configured calling services in one workspace. Apple Messages for Business can also be connected where the integration is enabled.
  • Customer messages can be organized into tickets with conversation history, internal notes, and assigned agents.
  • For example, a retail business operating in Orchard Road and Tampines can respond to product questions through Instagram, delivery inquiries through WhatsApp, and order complaints through email.
  • Hello also provides a mobile app for teams managing customer support outside the office.

faqs.question: Can MSG91 Hello combine rule-based workflows and agentic AI in one chatbot?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello allows Singapore businesses to combine structured chatbot steps with agentic AI inside one conversation.
  • A rule-based flow can collect booking details, order references, or service preferences. Agentic AI can then answer follow-up questions and use authorized integrations to retrieve relevant information.
  • For example, a hotel near Marina Bay can ask guests for their booking reference and use AI to explain room policies, check-in procedures, or connected reservation details.
  • MSG91 Hello provides no-code bot configuration, API workflows, multiple AI model options, and human-agent handover.
  • Multilingual configurations can also be created for different customer groups.

faqs.question: Can multiple agents manage one WhatsApp Business number using MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. Several support agents can manage the same connected WhatsApp Business number with separate logins through MSG91 Hello.
  • Managers can create teams, assign conversations, review ticket history, and transfer issues between departments.
  • For example, a Singapore electronics retailer can direct questions about product availability to sales, delivery requests to logistics, and warranty problems to customer support.
  • Hello includes unlimited agents across its plans, allowing businesses to expand support teams without individual per-agent license fees.
  • This is useful for companies managing multiple retail locations or different customer service departments.
  • Want to make it easier for customers to contact your business on WhatsApp? Use MSG91's Free WhatsApp Link Generator to create click-to-chat links, QR codes and website chat widgets with optional pre-filled messages. Once your WhatsApp Business channel is connected to MSG91 Hello, your support team can manage customer conversations from the shared inbox.

faqs.question: Can Singapore businesses manage customer calls through MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello includes cloud calling and IVR tools for configured customer service workflows.
  • Businesses can create calling routes, organize department responsibilities, and manage call-related support records alongside messaging conversations.
  • For example, a Singapore property services company can direct maintenance calls, tenant inquiries, and billing questions to different teams.
  • Agents can also initiate outbound customer support calls through the Hello mobile app in configured calling environments.
  • AI voice assistance can be used for suitable customer interactions, with setup requirements depending on whether the experience uses website voice chat or telephone calling.

faqs.question: What is MSG91 Chat Window, and how does it reduce WhatsApp support costs?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Chat Window lets a business begin a conversation on WhatsApp and continue the interaction through a separate chat window managed in Hello.
  • This is useful for customers who need detailed assistance with refunds, technical problems, order changes, or bookings.
  • For example, a Singapore electronics store can receive an initial WhatsApp complaint about a faulty product and continue the troubleshooting process through Chat Window.
  • Messages sent inside Chat Window do not incur Meta WhatsApp per-message charges. Messages sent on WhatsApp remain subject to applicable Meta pricing.
  • This helps businesses manage longer support conversations more efficiently.

faqs.question: How does MSG91 Hello compare with Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello offers unlimited agents without separate per-agent license fees, alongside ticket management, AI chatbot automation, and omnichannel support.
  • The platform combines rule-based chatbot steps and agentic AI, offers API integrations, and provides Chat Window for WhatsApp-originated customer service conversations.
  • For Singapore companies looking for omnichannel customer support software, Hello can bring different departments and communication channels into one workspace.
  • Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, and Intercom also provide helpdesk and automation products, but their individual plans, capabilities, and charges vary.

faqs.question: How much does MSG91 Hello cost in Singapore? Is there a free plan?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. The Singapore pricing page lists two free options and two paid monthly plans.
    • Live Chat – £0/month: One inbox with unlimited live-chat tickets.
    • Free – £0/month: Two inboxes and 50 tickets monthly.
    • Basic – £35/month: Two inboxes, 1,000 tickets, and a £35 bot wallet.
    • Premium – £65/month: Three inboxes, 2,000 tickets, and a £65 bot wallet.
  • Every plan includes unlimited agents and teams.
  • Currency note: The Singapore pricing page currently displays GBP rather than SGD. Businesses should confirm their billing currency and taxes before subscribing.
  • Explore MSG91 Hello Singapore Pricing

faqs.question: Are there extra charges for agents, tickets, inboxes, or AI bots?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello includes unlimited agents without per-agent license fees.
  • According to the listed paid monthly rates:
    • Extra inboxes: £9 per inbox.
    • Extra tickets: £0.012 per ticket on Basic and £0.025 on Premium.
    • AI bot usage: Deducted from the bot wallet according to the rate card.
  • When bot-wallet funds are exhausted, businesses can top up their balance. The Free plan requires an upgrade for additional ticket or inbox capacity.
  • Messaging and calling services may have separate charges.
  • View Complete Pricing

faqs.question: Is MSG91 Hello secure for Singapore businesses, and where is customer data stored?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 Hello helps Singapore businesses protect customer information through encryption, role-based permissions, and secure customer conversation management. MSG91 has undergone a SOC 2 Type II audit and holds ISO 27001 certification, demonstrating its commitment to information security.
  • MSG91 stores customer data for Singapore businesses in regional Asia-Pacific data centers, supporting Singapore's data residency requirements.
  • View MSG91 Security Certificates

faqs.question: Does MSG91 Hello offer free customer support software for Singapore startups?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 provides a Hello Free for Startups programme for eligible early-stage businesses looking for affordable customer support software in Singapore.
  • Registered startups with annual revenue below US$50,000 or the applicable local equivalent can apply for complimentary access, subject to verification.
  • The programme includes up to 1,000 monthly support tickets, 50 agents, 2 inboxes and AI chatbot usage under a fair-use policy.
  • For example, a Singapore retail startup can manage connected WhatsApp and website chat inquiries, use AI to answer common product questions, and route more detailed requests to its support team.
  • Businesses must provide registration and financial documents during the application process. Usage restrictions and separate communication charges apply.
  • Explore Hello Free for Startups

faqs.question: Can Singapore businesses save almost 95% on customer support software using MSG91 Hello?
faqs.answer:
• MSG91 Hello can help Singapore businesses reduce estimated customer support software expenses by around 95% in selected competitor comparisons.
  • For example, with 3,000 monthly tickets, 12 agents and 50% AI resolution:
    • MSG91 Hello: £59/month
    • Freshdesk: £915/month
    • Estimated savings: £856/month — 94% lower costs
  • Businesses can use the calculator to compare Hello with Zendesk, Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Intercom and other customer support platforms.
  • The calculator offers GBP, USD, INR and AED. Singapore businesses can choose GBP for comparison with the pricing displayed on the Singapore Hello page.
  • Actual savings depend on the selected plans, support volume and AI usage assumptions.
  • Compare Customer Support Software Costs
